query: INSERT INTO businesses.mailbox_check AS c (business_id, mailbox_id, change_for, replaces, requested_by, sent_at, window_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $6) ON CONFLICT (business_id, mailbox_id) DO UPDATE SET tries = CASE WHEN c.open AND c.window_at > $7 THEN c.tries ELSE 0 END, window_at = CASE WHEN c.open AND c.window_at > $7 THEN c.window_at ELSE $6 END, sent_at = $6, open = true, change_for = $3, replaces = $4, requested_by = $5 WHERE c.verified_at IS NULL OR c.returned_at IS NOT NULL OR $4::uuid IS NOT NULL RETURNING id AS "id!"
